notes.title: Message from developers
notes.content:
Hello players!

We listen to the opinion of players and try to fix the balance and bugs, it affects the game and sometimes makes the game rough around the edges, all such things we try to fix.

We play our game ourselves and when we think that some moment becomes too difficult, we correct this moment. 

For example, we had 3 locations in a row without shields. Оne location can be skipped. The second location has berries and with their help you can level up the guild of hunters and increase the number of shields dropped from monsters. We've redesigned the third location, and it has shields now. 

We are not too far ahead in the game, as we do not use bugs, we try to fix everything instead.

Some players have gotten far ahead in the game because of bugs or other reasons and complain about the imbalance. When we fix such bugs, players say that they can no longer move forward and leave negative comments and feedback.

For example, the experience required to gain a new level for heroes was not growing, players could gain 1000 levels and the required experience did not increase. After fixing this we received a lot of heath and negativity. Guild ranks contained a bug that caused them to have an infinite number of upgrades.
After fixing this bug, we also received negativity. Although we have mechanics planned to implement that will further increase the rank bonus. 

We don't do paywalls in the game, when we see mass complaints about such things, we try to fix such things. But it is not always done quickly and easily.

We realize that shields grow quite slowly and we added a deck of astral fruit. We also want to add
a separate tab to the game (Astral Garden) to simplify shield mining. In the earlier stages of the game we want to add guild quests that will allow you to strengthen guilds even more and faster. We are also preparing the next boss specials, which will also help in progression.

We have a lot of ideas for our game, but we are a small indie team and can't implement everything at once. The game is in early access and not everything is perfect.
We try to take into account all your comments and make changes as soon as possible, but the negativity and negative feedback is discouraging. So we look forward to your support :)
